summary: OceanLight Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K reporting consummation of its initial public offering of 10 million units at $10.00 per unit, grossing $100 million. Each unit includes one ordinary share, one right for one-fourth share, and one warrant exercisable at $11.50. Sponsor purchased 211,250 private placement units for $2.11 million. Proceeds placed in trust. This is a routine SPAC IPO formation event, not a special situation; no deal terms or strategic actions. Watch for future business combination announcements.
